name: agentic-dev-flow
description: The Agentic Dev Flow core and its plugins

plugins.name: adf
plugins.description: Agentic Dev Flow core: the spec-driven change cycle and the contract its plugins extend

plugins.name: adf-gitlab
plugins.description: ADF forge plugin for GitLab: pushes a change branch and keeps its merge request through glab

plugins.name: adf-english-check
plugins.description: Blocks an agent's git commit when a file in scope holds non-English prose

plugins.name: adf-memory
plugins.description: ADF knowledge plugin: an indexed wiki memory, a log rotated monthly, and the ingest, query and lint workflows

plugins.name: adf-maintainer
plugins.description: Upstream for the Agentic Dev Flow maintainer: files a retrospective's flow findings and the open ADF debt as GitHub issues through gh

plugins.name: adf-npm-workspaces
plugins.description: ADF provisioning for npm workspaces: a worktree's own node_modules with its workspace links inside the worktree, and a guard against npm install in a worktree

plugins.name: adf-postgres
plugins.description: ADF provisioning for PostgreSQL: a database per worktree, named from its branch, its URL in the worktree's env file, dropped at teardown

plugins.name: adf-prisma
plugins.description: ADF provisioning for Prisma: an own generated client, migrations and seed into a worktree's own database, and the migration-order check at verify

plugins.name: adf-jira
plugins.description: ADF tracker for Jira: gathers issues at propose, starts them and hands them to the tester after the merge, plus guarded two-phase Jira skills
